164    public function middleName($gender = null)
165    {
166        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
167            return static::middleNameMale();
168        }
169
170        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
171            return static::middleNameFemale();
172        }
173
174        return $this->generator->parse(static::randomElement(static::$middleNameFormat));
175    }
